categories.name: Creative coding and 2D
categories.description: Sketching frameworks and 2D raster or scene-graph renderers: p5, canvas, Skia, PixiJS, Paper.js.

categories.name: Animation and authored assets
categories.description: Tweening and timeline libraries, motion frameworks, and players for authored animation formats such as Lottie, Rive and AVAL.

categories.name: 3D rendering, shaders and effects
categories.description: Real-time and offline 3D renderers, WebGL and WebGPU layers, shader tooling, post-processing and path tracers.

categories.name: Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
categories.description: SVG authoring and rasterising, fonts and text shaping, maths typesetting, diagram languages and static layout to image.

categories.name: Video, capture and delivery
categories.description: Frame capture, encoding, composition, packaging, inspection and delivery metadata such as HDR.

categories.name: Image processing and colour
categories.description: Raster processing, optimisation, comparison, colour science and pixel treatments such as halftone or pixel sorting.

categories.name: Native applications and procedural tools
categories.description: Desktop applications driven headlessly and procedural or CAD modelling: Blender, Godot, OpenSCAD, build123d, OCCT.

categories.name: Physics and simulation
categories.description: Rigid-body, fluid and particle simulation whose results are baked or stepped for a scene.

categories.name: Audio, music and speech
categories.description: Synthesis, analysis, MIDI and notation, mixing and loudness, text to speech, transcription and alignment, separation and denoise.

categories.name: 3D assets and interchange
categories.description: glTF, USD and texture formats, mesh processing and booleans, reconstruction, avatars and Gaussian splats.

categories.name: Maps and geodata
categories.description: Map rendering, vector tiles, geodata conversion and elevation.

categories.name: Captions, accessibility and provenance
categories.description: Caption formats and checks, flashing and photosensitivity analysis, and content credentials.

categories.name: Reference data and asset sources
categories.description: APIs and libraries that supply icons, fonts, materials and media rather than render them.

note: A tool record's category must be exactly "<id>. <name>" from this list. Provenance (where a lead came from) belongs in the record's source, not its category. Propose a new category for a human to decide rather than inventing one.
